speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a significant medical history and are presenting with gait and limb ataxia; to begin our assessment, please describe your specific medical history and any prior neurological symptoms you have experienced. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab use. The combination of significant Crohn's disease, long-term natalizumab therapy, and new-onset gait and limb ataxia is highly suggestive of this opportunistic viral infection of the central nervous system. We will proceed immediately with the MRI results and consider discontinuation of natalizumab.
